verdict.rationale: A downloadable machine-readable API spec is a fair axis for a SaaS coding product with cloud agents and automations, so the story applies. The evidence does not show one: the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path. The llms.txt and markdown docs endpoints are adjacent machine-readable docs, not an API spec, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
